heading: DNA methylation is spatially organised around, but does not instruct, the regulatory genome of *Streptomyces coelicolor*: a 4mC/6mA methylome with a same-strand AAGCCCG dual modification
Abstract
Introduction
Results
R0. The three sampled timepoints capture distinct developmental and physiological states
R0b. Nanopore base-modification calling identifies a 4mC mark at GCCGGC and a same-strand dual modification of AAGCCCG
R1. The GCCGGC 4mC methylome is core-concentrated and largely stable across development, with arm-ward expansion at T2
R2. Both modification types are depleted from promoter-proximal regions genome-wide, with modestly stronger depletion at regulatory genes
R3. Vegetative GCCGGC methylation defines a core-localised Exposed/Shielded regulatory partition
R4. Exposed promoters retain their methylation across the developmental switch and show no directional expression response
R5. The three methylation gene sets show distinct pathway enrichment: quorum sensing (GCCGGC-proximal) and siderophore biosynthesis (dual-targeted)
R6. Positional stratification reveals CDS-dominant distribution and position-specific functional enrichment
